mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE urgency_class='URGENT' AND received_at<=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND ingest_status IN ('RECEIVED','PROCESSING','RETRY_PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED') AND disposition_status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE ingest_status IN ('FAILED','RETRY_PENDING') AND disposition_status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING') AND ((urgency_class='URGENT' AND received_at<=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) OR (urgency_class<>'URGENT' AND received_at<=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 120 MINUTE)))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE urgency_class='URGENT' AND received_at>=#{start} AND received_at<DATE_SUB(#{end},INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND ingest_status IN ('RECEIVED','PROCESSING','RETRY_PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED') AND disposition_status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE received_at>=#{start} AND received_at<#{end} AND ingest_status IN ('FAILED','RETRY_PENDING') AND disposition_status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING') AND ((urgency_class='URGENT' AND received_at<=DATE_SUB(#{end},INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) OR (urgency_class<>'URGENT' AND received_at<=DATE_SUB(#{end},INTERVAL 120 MINUTE)))
